task.description: Translate the listed Sai files from Russian into English, following decisions/0080-english-instructions.md exactly (read it first, including the glossary in item 5). Rules: (1) the meaning must not change — same rules, numbers, names, order of sections; do not shorten, improve or add rules; (2) keep unchanged every file name, identifier, field name, AP-NNN, REQ-NNN, ISS-NNNN, decision number, command, role code and code block; (3) the front matter keys stay, but name: and description: are written in English (the name keeps the form "Sai <Role> (CODE)"); (4) text that the owner or a customer reads and tool error messages stay in the original Russian when quoted, followed by a short English gloss in parentheses; (5) plain, short English sentences, one term per concept (use the glossary); (6) no computer paths and no names of other projects in the text; (7) write the file in place with the Write tool, do not run prettier on .md outside tools/. Do not use git checkout/reset/stash/clean and do not commit. Do not stop the demo server on port 4782. Before close run: cd tools && npm run handoffs-check and npm run traces. In result list the files you translated and anything you were unsure about (issues). Files to translate: docs/workflows/: handoffs.md, WF-01-requirement.md … WF-07-business-plan.md (8 files). Keep the file names; the Russian section titles that other files quote by name become English titles — list every changed title in result so cross references can be updated.
